## Load the libraries

lib = where to save the library (zonder = default)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

package_list <- c("mem", "data.table", "tidyverse", "naniar", "stringr", "readr",  "dplyr", "magrittr", "readxl", "writexl", "sjmisc", "tidyr", "openssl"
                  )
for (pkg in package_list) {
  if (pkg %in% rownames(.packages()) == FALSE)
  {library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)}

}
```

Load data sheet
```{r}

# Load Excel file
data <- read.csv("../Data/CleanedData/barometer_combined_2025-07-29.csv") 

```

Filter to include only the surveillance season weeks

```{r onlysurveillance, eval=TRUE}

# Keep only weeks 40–53 and 1–20
data <- subset(data, week >= 40 | week <= 20)

```


Transform the Data for MEM: MEM expects a wide format: each column is a season (e.g., "2015/2016"), each row is a week.

```{r}
# Create a season label based on week and year
data$season <- ifelse(data$week >= 40,
                      paste(data$year, data$year + 1, sep = "/"),
                      paste(data$year - 1, data$year, sep = "/"))

# Use MEM's transformdata function
transformed <- transformdata(
  i.data = data,
  i.range.x = c(40, 20),       # Week range
  i.name = "rate"             # Column with rates
)

# Extract the transformed data
mem_data <- transformed$data

```

Selection of seasons to include

```{r}
# Keep only the desired seasons
mem_data <- mem_data[, colnames(mem_data) %in% c(
  "2017/2018", "2018/2019", "2019/2020",
  "2020/2021", "2021/2022", "2022/2023"
)]
```



Aanvullen van missing values
```{r missing values, eval=TRUE}

mem_data <- transformseries(mem_data, i.transformation = 3)

```


Run the MEM Model

```{r}

mem_model <- memmodel(mem_data)
# View summary
summary(mem_model)
plot(mem_model)  # Basic plot of the epidemic model
full.series.graph(mem_data)
intensity <- memintensity(mem_model)
print(intensity)

```

Evaluate model performance

```{r}
goodness <- memgoodness(mem_data)
print(goodness$results)
```
